sources.SOURCE_TITLE: 食品安全国家标准 食品生产通用卫生规范
sources.PUBLISHER: 国家卫生健康委、市场监管总局；济阳区政府公开原文
sources.APPLICABILITY: Food-production premises/equipment; project-specific application requires professional review
sources.ENGINEERING_FACT: Clauses4.1.3,5.2.1.1.1,5.2.1.3.1-3.2 require capacity-appropriate space, process organization, and access for operation, cleaning and maintenance; no universal three-worker station pitch is supplied.
sources.LIMITATIONS: Effective2026-09-02. Live web fetch failed this task; previously downloaded government PDF bytes reverified and relevant pages5/8 visually checked. No numeric aisle or table size adopted.

sources.APPLICABILITY: Conveyor workstation task/user assessment, foreign guidance only
sources.ENGINEERING_FACT: Pages3/5/8 distinguish workstation height, working height, reach and foot/leg access; multiple operators may obstruct one another. A whole station cannot be inferred from nominal belt/table size.
sources.LIMITATIONS: Not Chinese mandatory code and not project anthropometric approval. No published reach/foot-clearance number is imported as a project hard default.

sources.APPLICABILITY: Conveyor/packing cleaning, guarding and foreseeable maintenance states
sources.ENGINEERING_FACT: Routine conveyor cleaning requires a safe work system; removal/access around guards and maintenance must be considered, rather than treating a production envelope as sufficient for every state.
sources.LIMITATIONS: Foreign guidance, not a Chinese legal clearance table. Historical standard references on the page are not adopted as verified-current standards.

sources.APPLICABILITY: Illustrative manual fruit carton/tray packing architecture
sources.ENGINEERING_FACT: Packaging supply is perpendicular to the line, product arrives via lower conveyors, packaging moves through an inclined section and returns horizontal, and reject fruit has a separate path.
sources.LIMITATIONS: No verified overall length/depth or project three-worker station dimensions. The image label1280x800 is not an equipment dimension. Not selected project machinery.

sources.APPLICABILITY: Illustrative hand-packing carrots/parsnips, not a blueberry design standard
sources.ENGINEERING_FACT: A rotary, adjustable-height arrangement is offered for up to four staff; operator organization depends on equipment architecture.
sources.LIMITATIONS: No verified diameter/footprint or project worker allocation. Up-to-four vendor capacity does not establish a three-worker rectangular station or its pitch.

sources.APPLICABILITY: Example of actual assembled work-table dimensions only
sources.ENGINEERING_FACT: Published assembled table/work surface is1800mm wide and700mm deep; feet adjust850-900mm. This is a physical product size, unlike station pitch.
sources.LIMITATIONS: Generic kitchen stainless table, not selected fruit-packing equipment. No evidence of three-person reach, feed/outfeed, hygienic process suitability or work envelope; not used as a proposed project size.

sources.SOURCE_TITLE: Alpine Slicing and Cheese Conversion Case Study
sources.VERSION: Manufacturer case study; installation reported fall2015
sources.APPLICABILITY: Real named food-packing installation, qualitative comparison only
sources.ENGINEERING_FACT: The published case combines height-adjustable conveyors and a packing table, oriented product delivery and a separate cleaning shutdown. The working system includes more than table footprint.
sources.LIMITATIONS: Cheese packaging, not blueberries; reported benefits are manufacturer claims, not an independent validation for this project. No project line count, runtime, room area or staffing imported. Main URL redirected to/europe; matching publisher HTML was also read directly.
